name: tenants_change_exchange_rate
description: Correct an exchange rate, by exchange_rate_id from tenants_exchange_rates. Its pair and applies_from don't change: remove the rate and add another for that. Every report that converts on a date it covers changes with it. A rate is a decimal string above zero with at most twelve decimal places, such as "0.92": one unit of from_currency is worth that much to_currency. Refused unless the caller is a tenant admin.
